channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Embr
item.description: Fight fires for fun and profit in this unpredictable and frantic multiplayer game. Team up with friends, take on daily challenges and climb to the top of the corporate firefighting ladder. More than one way to become a hero!

item.title: Just Die Already
item.description: Just Die Already is an old people mayhem sandbox game created by the designers of Goat Simulator. You are old and angry and you've just been kicked out of your retirement home. How will you survive in a world that wants you to Just Die Already?

item.title: Owlboy
item.description: Owlboy is a story-driven platform adventure game, where you can fly and explore a brand new world in the clouds! Pick up your friends, and bring them with you as you explore the open skies, in one of the most detailed adventures of this era.

item.title: Korea. IL-2 Series
item.description: Korea. IL-2 Series is a next-generation flight simulator set during the Korean War. Climb into the cockpit of early jet fighters and shape the outcome of legendary aerial battles.

item.title: Lacey's Flash Games
item.description: These are the REAL girls’ games. Charlie (Charchar887) discovers Lacey's mid-2000s Flash games and their disturbing secrets. Enter the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the website's missing creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey and her friends!

item.title: Asleep: Act 1
item.description: Use light to survive a nightmare: each creature reacts differently to it. Explore, solve puzzles, and evade the horrors in the dark. You are in the skin of Ana Lúcia.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.
